title: Thesis introduction: does it now motivate the contribution and empirical/AI approach?
body:
The revised introduction now begins with the thesis’s contribution to computational symplectic geometry, the purpose of its empirical investigations, and the role of AI-assisted research. Viterbo’s conjecture and prior work follow.

Please read [the revised opening, pp. 5–6](https://joern-pc.tailc5e761.ts.net/files?project=msc-math-worktrees&path=opening-pass-2026-10-23%2Fthesis%2Fbuild%2Fmain.pdf&page=5). Does it now motivate the thesis’s contribution and empirical/AI approach as you intended?

A separate Astra/high reviewer, without inherited parent conversation, checked prose, page fit and agreement with the manuscript. This was not proof verification or whole-thesis acceptance.

[review: 01a16daa-70c3-7fa2-bd00-298c9f2ce022]
answer: this again isn't a good introduction. i am not sure what the problem is? writing introductions is a solved problem. idgi.
